title: The REAL reason behind the housing crisis
summary: Gary's Economics argues that the UK housing crisis stems from wealth inequality, treating housing as an asset like shares that rich people bid up. He contends that simply building more housing won't fix affordability.
why: HN commenters share it as a counterargument to the YIMBY build-more-housing view, linking wealth concentration to asset prices.

quote.text: It feels to me like a good faith counterargument to the YIMBY build more housing line of thought, so might be an interesting perspective
